individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart shows median state frequency across many finely-binned promoter groups (n=5912); this binned aggregate trend is analogous to a line/density plot where overlaying thousands of individual promoter values would be unreadable.
Each row of the single-molecule stack represents an individual DNA molecule's methylation pattern, so individual data points underlying the summarized state frequencies are shown.
